apps.name: SayoSign
apps.subtitle: Sign, inject, install. On your iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription: SayoSign signs IPA files right on your iPhone with your .p12 or Apple ID, injects tweaks with its own SayoHook engine, checks certificate revocation via OCSP and installs apps offline through an on-device HTTPS server.

versions.localizedDescription: Apple ID sign-in works again: anisette v3 with Mac-based servers (Apple rejects Android anisette since October 2026), clear error messages and server check in Settings. Fixed the certificate picker (files no longer greyed out, iCloud/Telegram files load). New Light / Black / System themes. Scan the QR code from SayoSign Desktop to use your PC as an anisette server.
First public release: .p12 and Apple ID signing, tweak injection with SayoHook, OCSP check, offline installs. English, Russian and Simplified Chinese.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: SayoSign runs a tiny server on this iPhone to install signed apps.

news.title: SayoSign 1.1 — Apple ID works again
news.caption: Anisette v3 with Mac servers, fixed certificate picker, black theme.

news.title: SayoSign 1.0.0
news.caption: First public release. Now in English, Русский and 中文.
